timeline.event: Alden announces changes to his will at dinner.
The household disperses to its claimed rooms.
Iris enters the study with the corrected will.
Alden and Iris argue; the study clock runs ten minutes slow.
A glass breaks in the study; Mrs. Vale hears it from the hall.
Iris leaves through the study's service door and pulls the thread-release hidden behind the curtain; the door locks from inside.
Tom sees a blue coat at the rose arch.
Nurse Adeline sees the hall lights flicker and checks the study corridor.
The study is forced open; Alden is found dead and the corrected will is gone.

suspects.name: Iris Vale
suspects.relationship: Alden's private secretary and Mrs. Vale's daughter
suspects.motive: A secret Alden held over her

suspects.name: Ronan Rosewood
suspects.motive: A lost inheritance and a torn will page

witnesses.name: Mrs. Vale
witnesses.observation: heard glass break from the hall at 20:05 and says she saw no one leave the study
witnesses.reliability: protective lie: she hides Iris's presence until the notes are compared

witnesses.name: Tom
witnesses.observation: saw a blue coat pass the rose arch at 20:10
witnesses.reliability: reliable once the study clock correction is applied

witnesses.name: Nurse Adeline
witnesses.observation: saw the hall lights flicker at 20:12 and found the corridor empty
witnesses.reliability: reliable but read the slow study clock as 20:02

clues.whatItShows: Five suspects had access and motive.
Ronan tore a page but did not enter the study.
Dev argued with Alden before dinner ended.
The study clock runs ten minutes slow.
A blue coat left the west wing at 20:10.
Mrs. Vale hid Iris's 20:05 visit to the study.
A thread-release let the killer lock the door after leaving.
Alden threatened to expose Iris's forged credentials.
The corrected will would remove Iris's protection.

method.name: constraint search
method.plainDescription: Line up the facts, test each claim, and reject any arrangement that breaks a clue.

solution.exit: service door and hidden curtain thread-release
solution.clockTrick: the study clock runs ten minutes slow
